We need to combine subnetworks into full topology. Likely just merge resistor IDs with unique names? Need to ensure no duplicate IDs across subnets. Subnet 1 uses R1,R2. Subnet2 also R1,R2,R3. Subnet3 R1-4. Subnet4 R1-4. Must rename to avoid collisions, maybe prefix with subnet number. Also combine connections. Provide JSON with resistors dict and connections list.

We have notes: total resistors 13. Let's count unique resistors across subnets: subnet1 2, subnet2 3, subnet3 4, subnet4 4 =13. So they intend to keep same names but they are distinct per subnet? But names duplicate; maybe they are separate components but same label allowed? Probably need to rename to unique: R1_1 etc. But total 13 suggests they consider each resistor distinct even if same label across subnets. So we need to rename to unique IDs.

Now connections: need to adjust resistor IDs.

Subnet3: ["X2","N_c1","R1"],["N_c1","N_c2","R2"],["N_c2","N_c3","R3"],["N_c3","X3","R4"].

Subnet4: ["B","N_d1","R1"],["N_d1","N_d2","R2"],["N_d2","N_d3","R3"],["N_d3","X3","R4"].

Combine all.
